facts.subject: Lahıc (Ismayilli district), village of coppersmiths on the southern slopes of the Greater Caucasus, about a 3-hour drive west of Baku (Euronews 2021). Copper craftsmanship of Lahij inscribed on UNESCO's Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity in 2015 (UNESCO ich.unesco.org 00675; Wikipedia 'Lahıc copper craft' — 3 Dec 2015, 10.COM; Euronews; AzerNews). One family workshop opened in 1725 and still works today — 'his workshop is 300 years old. It was opened in 1725' (Euronews, coppersmith of the Aliyev family; Wikipedia: 'The Aliyev family … started this craft … in 1725'). Lahij copperware is kept in the Louvre in Paris (Euronews; AzerNews). Cobbled streets, stone houses 'look just as they did centuries ago' (Euronews; Wikipedia village). ~40 types of copper items (Wikipedia — not used as a number, single source). NOT used: 'sewage 1000–1500 years old' (Wikipedia says 'some experts claim'), ~200 workshops mid-19th c. and 1878 Paris gold medal (Wikipedia only), altitude 1 211 m (single), coppersmith's personal name (private person).

facts.subject: Karabakh horse (Qarabağ atı), Azerbaijan's mountain-steppe riding breed, famous for its golden-tinted chestnut/bay coat (Wikipedia; AzerNews). 1956: among the gifts to Queen Elizabeth II was the Karabakh horse 'Zaman', presented by Nikita Khrushchev; it was not shown at Windsor (AzerNews x2 2022; modern.az; woman&home 2022 'gifted one in 1956 … named Zaman'). 2012: Karabakh horses performed at the Royal Windsor Horse Show for the Queen's Diamond Jubilee (Wikipedia). 16 May 2022: the Queen received a Karabakh horse named Şöhrət ('Glory') from Azerbaijan for her Platinum Jubilee (Wikipedia citing The Telegraph 17 May 2022; woman&home). 1956 → 2022 = 66 years. Chovqan (horse-riding game on Karabakh horses) on UNESCO's Urgent Safeguarding List (AzerNews; UNESCO title 'Chovqan, a traditional Karabakh horse-riding game' 2013 — VERIFY on ich.unesco.org at build before using). NOT used: 'breed below 1 000' (Wikipedia citing CNN 2011 — dated), Kishmish 2004 speed (ambiguous unit), Aghdam stud farm (conflict-adjacent), Natavan 1867 Paris medal (single source).

Kraliçanın iki Qarabağ atı: 1956 və 2022 🐎

1956-cı ildə Nikita Xruşşov Britaniya kraliçası II Elizabetə «Zaman» adlı Qarabağ atı hədiyyə etdi. Bu cins qızılı parıltılı tükü ilə tanınır. 2012-ci ildə Qarabağ atları Vindzorda Kraliçanın yubileyində çıxış etdi. 2022-ci ildə isə Azərbaycan Kraliçaya yenə Qarabağ atı bağışladı — adı «Şöhrət» idi. Ən maraqlısı: iki hədiyyənin arasında düz 66 il var.
